name: Glass team chat message
oneLiner: a team channel on a glass pane: a message posts with a highlight flash, reactions pile on underneath with their counts climbing, your own fire reaction bursts, then the thread link stacks its avatars and the reply count rolls up
say: when the speaker shares news with their team or a win landing at work ('I posted it in the team channel', 'everyone went crazy'): the message posts on the news, the reactions pile on as they describe the response
